title: The Time Clock User system role is non-editable (lock icon, eye only)
preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list.
steps:
1. Find the Time Clock User row.
  2. Look at the role name column.
  3. Look at the Actions column.
  4. Click the eye icon.
expected:
A lock icon shows next to Time Clock User.

The Actions column has only the eye icon.

The eye opens a read-only Permission Summary.
